lake-lucerne.note: SGV's own point-to-point shop. Tokens must be spelled exactly as the shop spells them (didok--fluelen--8508476 fills the field, SGV's own page's didok--Flueelen--8508476 does not); there is no rule, so it is a table, every entry checked in a real browser as origin and destination (2026-09-21). Weggis is the shop's Weggis Schiffstation (8505670), not our 8508463. Never use the shop's journeyId/routeId links: issued per search by its backend, not computable.

lake-zurich.note: ZSG sells no tickets of its own; its boats are ZVV zone fares (zsg.ch fares page, 2026-09-22). ZVV's timetable search takes official station names; each result has ZVV's own Buy ticket button already scoped to the right zones (checked in a browser, 2026-09-22). products=16 is ZVV's boats-only filter, copied from a real search. fallbackUrl only if a pier has no full name.

lake-geneva.note: CGN's Magento shop: a plain GET search, no session or CSRF token (requested directly 2026-09-28; station codes echoed back in the page's own later-departures link). Codes read from the shop's own station dropdown. No time param exists, so the link shows the whole day. Lugrin has no CGN code, so no link from/to it.

lake-lugano.note: SNL's shop page reads departure_stop_id, arrival_stop_id, date and time off its own URL and runs the search (found in its JS bundle, 2026-09-28). Stop ids from its own GET /api/stops; confirmed by calling GET /api/trips with them (after POST /api/session) and getting real sailings and prices back. Cima, Gandria Confine, Oria, Osteno, Porlezza and S. Mamete never appear in /api/stops, so no link from/to them.

lake-zug.note: Zug sells fixed round-trip products online, no point-to-point fare, so there is no search to link into.

lake-thun.note: BLS shop is a Nuxt SPA (Cariboo platform, tenant bls_schiff) whose bundle reads nothing from the page URL (checked 2026-09-28).

lake-brienz.note: Same operator and shop as Lake Thun.

lake-biel.note: TYPO3 search form needs a per-session cHash: submitting real place ids returned "Kein Abfahrtsort gefunden" (2026-09-28).

lake-neuchatel.note: ASP.NET search needs a per-session __RequestVerificationToken: a GET with FromId/ToId returned the unchanged form (2026-09-28).

lake-murten.note: Same operator and shop as Lake Neuchatel.

lake-maggiore.note: SNL's ticket shop never lists a Maggiore stop (checked /api/stops on two dates) and no separate Maggiore shop exists, so this is SNL's timetable/ticket info page.

lake-constance.note: Two operators (SBS + BSB), both legacy reservation widgets with no query-string handling in their JS (2026-09-28). BSB schedule page covers the whole lake.
